settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; the day=value check reads the day as the text between the first and second '/'

book: single-txn-test (:81-94): top-level ASSET account-1, EXPENSE account-2 and INCOME account-3, and one transaction per day of the current month, day N moving $N from account-3 to account-1. asset-test (:263-275) builds the same accounts and transactions (in GnuCash's run, in the book of multi-acct-test), so both run on this book. For the pinned now the month is March 2024, and the relative options start-this-month and end-this-month read 2024-03-01 00:00:00 and 2024-03-31 23:59:59 UTC.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults. {"relative": name} is a relative date resolved from now.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109) after stripping <script> elements: table 1; row 0 is the <th> header row, row N the Nth data row, null every row; column 1 is the date. A check with "count" expects the number of cells selected rather than their text.

renderOnly.note: null-test: Income Over Time and Expense Over Time render with default options before single-txn-test (:60-61); Assets Over Time and Liabilities Over Time before asset-test (:67-68)

checks.name: day=value
checks.relation: For each row, the number after the first '/' of column 1 (the day of the month) equals the number in column 2 (the day's income), both read keeping only digits, '-' and '.'.
checks.meaning: Daily income, shown positive (Income Over Time reverses income signs, category-barchart.scm:733). GnuCash checks only the relation; the implied strings assume the C locale's %m/%d/%y.

checks.name: 2 columns
checks.meaning: Two header cells: Date and the account
